newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African May gold/forex reserves 21.8 bln rand.
newsitem.headline: S.African May gold/forex reserves 21.8 bln rand.

text.p: South Africa's combined gold and foreign exchange reserves jumped 7.4 billion rand in May to 21.8 billion rand from April's 14.4 billion rand, the Reserve Bank said on Monday.
The central bank added that the utilisation of foreign credit lines at the end of May was 1.8 billion rand, compared to 2.5 billion at the end of April.
It gave only a preliminary headline figure, adding a full breakdown would be published on Friday.
Analysts polled by Reuters had predicted combined reserves of 16.0 to 20.0 billion rand, with the consensus at 17.7 billion.
